messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "first dose usually taken before surgery, chemotherapy, or radiation treatment"
set: ["first dose usually taken before surgery, chemotherapy, or radiation treatment", "radiation treatment", "first dose of the day is usually taken when first wake up", "treatment usually started at lower dose", "do this before first dose", "usually taken for life", "long-term treatment is not usually stopped before surgery", "before first use", "usually taken once per day", "taken in first trimester", "caregiver should be trained before first dose", "first dose of 8 mg taken twice a day", "first few months of treatment", "oral dose taken 1 hour before induction of anesthesia", "dose taken 30 minutes before start of single-day HEC", "usually taken once a day in the evening"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
